module: Code shared by the editors of "mesh"-type node objects (MeshRoad and River) of the world editor. It is not an extension loaded by extensions.load: meshRoadEditor.lua and riverEditor.lua load it with dofile() then set M.type, M.preferencesName and M.niceName before wiring its "_"-suffixed functions to their edit mode. It handles the selection of the mesh and its nodes, creation by Alt+click, node insertion, width dragging, field copy/paste, deletion, undo/redo history, highlighting and preferences (default width, depth, height).
notes: The module variables (M.type, M.preferencesName, M.niceName) must be set by the calling editor BEFORE onActivate_ / onEditorRegisterPreferences_; otherwise the preference paths are invalid.
Since dofile() re-evaluates the file, each editor (road, river) has its own isolated copy of the state (selected node, copied fields).
Alt held = creation mode: clicking on empty space creates a mesh or adds a node; clicking on the selected mesh inserts an interpolated node (average width, depth, normal).
Minor bug: meshRoadEditor.lua and riverEditor.lua export M.onEditorGui_, M.deleteNodeAM and M.selectAllNodes from this module, but it does not define them: these fields are nil on the editors' side.
The functions of the exported list use the "_" suffix so they are not confused with the hooks of the extension that wraps them.

copySettingsAM.desc: Called by the action map (copy): remembers the fields of the selected mesh (editor.copyFields) for a later paste or to initialize a new mesh. Does nothing if no mesh is selected.

pasteFieldsAM.desc: Called by the action map (paste): applies the remembered fields to the selected mesh via a "PasteMeshFields" history action (undo/redo possible). Does nothing without a selected mesh or without a copy.

onActivate_.desc: Called when the edit mode is activated: computes the mode name ("Edit" .. M.type) and synchronizes the selection with the editor.

onDeleteSelection.desc: Deletes the selection: the selected nodes if the mesh keeps more than 2, otherwise the whole mesh. Goes through the editor history (undo/redo).

onDeselect_.desc: Called when the edit mode is exited: deselects the node and clears the object selection.

onEditorAxisGizmoAligmentChanged_.desc: Hook: when the axis gizmo alignment changes (and this mode is active), repositions the gizmo on the selected node. The name contains the game's typo "Aligment".

onEditorInspectorFieldChanged_.desc: Hook: when an inspector field changes, regenerates the meshes of the handled type if the field is segmentLength or subdivideLength.

selectedIds.desc: Ids of the objects whose field changed.

arrayIndex.desc: Index in an array field (unused here).

onEditorInspectorHeaderGui_.desc: Hook: draws, in the inspector header, the panel of the selected nodes' properties (width, depth, height) when this mode is active and a mesh with selected nodes exists.

inspectorInfo.desc: Inspector information provided by the editor.

onEditorObjectSelectionChanged_.desc: Hook: when the object selection changes (mode active), keeps the id of the first object of type M.type as the current mesh.

onEditorPreferenceValueChanged_.desc: Hook: recomputes the height offset (heightOffset) when the preference <preferencesName>.general.defaultHeight changes.

path.desc: Full path of the modified preference.

onEditorRegisterPreferences_.desc: Hook: registers the preferences category M.preferencesName with defaultWidth (10), defaultDepth (5), defaultHeight (2), dragWidth, highlightNearby and highlightNearbyDistance (100 m).

onSelectAll.desc: Selects all the nodes of the current mesh (indices 0 to getNodeCount()-1).

onToolbar_.desc: Draws the mode toolbar: default width and depth, "Highlight nearby" checkbox and highlight distance in meters. The values are written to the preferences.

onUpdate_.desc: Called every frame while the mode is active: detects the hovered node or mesh, handles the mouse raycast, Alt+click creation of meshes and nodes, width dragging, highlighting and debugDrawer drawing (spheres and help texts).
